mapper.sql: SELECT n.*, b.title AS book_title, b.author AS book_author, c.stage_title AS chapter_title FROM book_notes n LEFT JOIN books b ON b.id=n.book_id AND ((b.owner_id=n.user_id AND b.visibility!='removed') OR (b.status='completed' AND b.visibility='public' AND b.moderation_status IN ('unreviewed','approved') AND b.asset_scope IN ('private','verified-shared'))) LEFT JOIN chapters c ON c.id=n.chapter_id AND c.book_id=b.id WHERE n.user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: ORDER BY n.created_at DESC,n.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_notes WHERE user_id=#{userId}
SELECT * FROM book_notes WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE book_notes SET note=#{note},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM book_notes WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
